sovereign_country.strategic_role: 苏伊士运河经济特区、辐射中东及北非的低成本轻工制造

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Electronic Medical Record (EMR) Clinical Workflow Software

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid – predominantly Civil Law codified system in the Napoleonic/French tradition, supplemented by Islamic Sharia as the principal source of legislation (Article 2 of the 2014 Constitution), with limited Common Law influence in investment arbitration practice.
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Egypt-European Union Association Agreement (in force 2004; establishes free trade area with investment protection provisions)
Egypt-United States Trade and Investment Framework Agreement (TIFA, 1999)
COMESA Treaty membership (Common Market for Eastern and Southern Africa)
Greater Arab Free Trade Area (GAFTA) membership
Egypt-United Kingdom Agreement for the Promotion and Protection of Investments (with ISDS clause)
Egypt-Germany Investment Protection and Promotion Treaty, as amended by the 2005 Protocol
Egypt-Netherlands Investment Promotion and Protection Agreement
Egypt-UAE Investment and Capital Transfer Protection Agreement
Egypt-China Investment Protection Agreement (in force since 2016)
Comprehensive network of bilateral double taxation avoidance agreements (DTAAs), including with the United States, United Kingdom, Germany, the Netherlands, Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, and the UAE

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law No. 80 of 2002 on Combating Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing, as amended by Laws No. 78 of 2003, No. 181 of 2008, and No. 36 of 2014, and its Executive Regulations (Prime Ministerial Decree No. 1892 of 2002, as amended); Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 and its Executive Regulations; Companies Law No. 159 of 1981; Commercial Registry Law No. 34 of 1976; and GAFI Beneficial Ownership Disclosure and UBO Registration Requirements adopted pursuant to FATF Recommendation 24.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation and Certificate of Good Standing of each foreign corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent companies registry or registrar in the shareholder's country of origin (e.g., Companies House, Secretary of State, or equivalent authority)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille pursuant to the Hague Apostille Convention of 5 October 1961 (Egypt acceded on 14 March 2022; in force since 14 September 2022). If the origin state is not an Apostille party, full consular legalization through the Egyptian Embassy or Consulate is mandatory.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolution authorizing the incorporation of the Egyptian LLC and appointment of local incorporation agents
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of Directors of the foreign corporate shareholder, notarized at origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization in the origin state followed by Hague Apostille; no additional Egyptian consular legalization required for apostilled documents.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney granted to the GAFI-licensed local counsel / incorporation agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Foreign corporate shareholder officers or Egyptian Notary Public (Ma'muriyya)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille for foreign-executed POAs; alternatively, execution before an Egyptian Notary Public and registration in the notary records (no apostille required for locally executed POAs).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Draft Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association (Arabic original; English certified translation annexed)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Egyptian corporate counsel, executed by incorporators and authenticated before the Egyptian Ma'muriyya
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Local notarization only; no apostille required because the document is executed in Egypt and filed with the GAFI one-stop-shop.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Beneficial Ownership (UBO) declaration form with supporting identification for each natural-person UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Authorized incorporators and managers; submitted through the GAFI UBO electronic registration module
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Electronic submission to GAFI. Supporting identification for foreign UBOs (notarized passports, corporate ownership chart) must be apostilled where origin documents are relied upon.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified passport copies of statutory directors, managers, and 25%+ shareholders/UBOs
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport issuing authority or notary public in the country of nationality or residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization at origin and Hague Apostille for each foreign national; locally notarized copies for Egyptian nationals.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-incorporation screening of all directors, managers, shareholders, and UBOs against the US OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council Consolidated Lists, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, and the domestic Egyptian AML unit (EMTFCU) terrorist-designation register. PEP identification is required under Law No. 80 of 2002 and Central Bank of Egypt regulations, executed through risk-based screening using international data vendors (WorldCheck / LexisNexis or equivalent). Negative results must be documented and retained for at least five years. Any PEP or sanctions hit, regardless of ownership percentage, triggers enhanced due diligence, senior management approval, and notification to the EMTFCU where required.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: GAFI One-Stop-Shop (OSS) online company registration module, accessible via the Invest in Egypt portal (investinegypt.gov.eg); name clearance is coordinated with the Egyptian Commercial Registry operating under the Ministry of Trade and Industry.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The statutory company name must be rendered in Arabic and recorded in the Arabic Commercial Registry. A transliterated English/Latin version may be registered as an auxiliary name, provided the Arabic official name remains the primary legal identifier. The name must not be identical or confusingly similar to an earlier registered trade name, must comply with public order prohibitions (Companies Law No. 159 of 1981, Article 33, and Commercial Registry Law No. 34 of 1976), and, for a HealthTech EMR entity, must not imply clinical or healthcare practice capability beyond the stated software-as-a-service scope without statutory licensure.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Islamic Sharia-related terms (require prior endorsement of the Ministry of Religious Affairs)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon name rejection, the applicant may (1) file a written objection with the GAFI Investor Support and Complaints Committee within 15 business days of the rejection notice, attaching the official rejection letter and two alternative names; (2) if the Committee upholds the rejection, initiate an annulment action before the Administrative Court of the Egyptian State Council within 60 days from notification, in accordance with State Council Law No. 149 of 1973; and/or (3) simultaneously reserve a new name through the OSS at the standard reservation fee, preserving the overall incorporation timetable.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not acceptable as the sole statutory head office. Egyptian company law and GAFI practice require a physical, leased or owned office address in Egypt, reflected in the Memorandum of Association and Commercial Registry. For a low-risk EMR-HIPAA cloud SaaS company, a virtual or registered-agent-only address is administratively insufficient because (i) the GAFI one-stop-shop requires site documentation (lease, ownership, or usufruct), (ii) the Personal Data Protection Law No. 151 of 2020 requires a verifiable establishment for health data controllers, and (iii) the Ministry of Communications and Information Technology software license inspection presupposes physical presence. Hybrid arrangements (serviced offices with dedicated working space) may be accepted where substantiated by a lease agreement.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low-to-moderate: approximately 10% probability per year for a standard-risk software LLC, rising to 15-20% in the first 12 months post-licensing, given the 2021-2024 FATF mutual evaluation follow-up enhancements, GAFI's intensified UBO enforcement, and Ministry of Health digital-certification reviews of EMR vendors.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Company name reservation and clearance (primary name plus one alternative)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under the GAFI fee schedule (approx. EGP 1,200 per electronic reservation request)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO registration and AML/CFT due diligence filing fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory e-government processing fee plus AML registration charge

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization and Hague Apostille block (four foreign corporate documents)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Foreign notaries and competent authorities in the origin jurisdiction
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official apostille tariffs (USD 15-30 per document) plus secured courier costs

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified English-to-Arabic and Arabic-to-English translation of corporate documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministry of Justice-licensed translation office in Cairo
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market rate (EGP 700-1,000 per certified A4 page; estimated 10-12 pages)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Egyptian Notary Public (Ma'muriyya) certification of incorporation documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory notary tariff (approx. EGP 2,000 aggregating signature authentications and certified copies)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: PEP and sanctions screening (OFAC, UN, EU, EMTFCU domestic lists) for 3-4 natural persons
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Third-party screening vendor / law firm compliance department
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark of USD 45-60 per individual per comprehensive global screening event

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Local counsel pre-incorporation legal opinion, corporate record review, and name-clearance submission
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Egyptian corporate and AML-focused law firm representing the incorporators
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market fixed fee for an LLC pre-incorporation package (range USD 1,500-2,500; quantified at mid-point)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Commercial Registry entry and GAFI LLC incorporation statutory fees
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: GAFI One-Stop-Shop and Egyptian Commercial Registry
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory fixed fees under Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 and Commercial Registry Law No. 34 of 1976 (approx. EGP 24,000 aggregate)

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Companies Law No. 159 of 1981 (as amended by Law No. 4 of 2018 and Law No. 183 of 2020), Articles 75-96 governing Limited Liability Companies; Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 applicable to the One-Stop Shop procedure.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) – Companies Registration and Notarization Department (One-Stop Shop).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum of Association (Articles of Incorporation / Contract of Incorporation) and the official GAFI Company Incorporation Application Form.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for an Egyptian Limited Liability Company; capital is fixed in the Memorandum of Association and divided into nominal shares. No escrow account mandated, but a bank capital deposit certificate must be submitted with the incorporation application.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: Resolved, that the articles of incorporation of EG_LLC are approved; the managers accept the allocated share capital subscriptions specified in the Memorandum; the registered office is established at the address named in the incorporation file, located in the Arab Republic of Egypt. That the following officers are appointed to hold office until the annual meeting: First Manager and Managing Director; Executive Secretary; and Compliance Officer. That the appointed officers are authorized to execute and file the package, to open accounts, and to obtain all applicable regulatory and ministerial licenses, permits, and certifications.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI One-Stop Shop / Commercial Registry Name Clearance Window
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation application for the intended English and Arabic corporate name. The name must be distinguishable from existing trade names and must not violate public order or Law No. 159/1981. Use the GAFI e-portal or attend the One-Stop Shop. Obtain a formal name clearance certificate before proceeding.
required_dossiers: Photocopies of founder passports or national IDs
Power of Attorney if filed by a representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is rejected, select an alternative name and submit a fresh reservation through the same GAFI window within five business days; the filing fee is partially credited.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarization and Execution of Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI Legal Documentation / Certified Notary Lawyer
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Articles of Association in Arabic using a licensed legal practitioner. State the corporate activities, including 'development and operation of electronic medical record clinical workflow software and related software-as-a-service platforms'. All founders must sign before a GAFI notary or certified lawyer. Verify that share subscription allocations and capital structure match the approved name file, and pay notarial and stamp duties.
required_dossiers: Passport or national ID of each founder
Power of Attorney if signing by proxy
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary returns the file for correction, execute a notarized supplementary deed amending the relevant provisions and resubmit for certification within three business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Share Capital Deposit and Bank Certification
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary bank account in the name of the company under formation. Deposit the cash contribution, or obtain an appraisal report for in-kind contributions. The bank must issue a preliminary capital certificate stating the deposited amount and the purpose of the account, which will be replaced by the account of the incorporated company after registration.
required_dossiers: Valuation report for in-kind contributions, if applicable
Authenticated identification of the subscription officer
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank certificate lacks the required legal wording, request a corrected certificate from the bank operations department specifying the company formation purpose and deposit date.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Incorporation Filing at GAFI One-Stop Shop
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI One-Stop Shop – Company Registration Department
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the full incorporation dossier to the GAFI One-Stop Shop. The file must include the notarized Memorandum of Association, the preliminary bank capital certificate, the name clearance, the completed incorporation application, and the good-standing affidavits of the managers. Pay the statutory government fee and receive an official acknowledgment. GAFI will review compliance with Companies Law No. 159/1981 and Investment Law No. 72/2017 within the statutory window.
required_dossiers: Executed and notarized Memorandum of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If GAFI raises a query or requires amendment, lodge an explanatory response and rectify the issue through the same GAFI portal within ten business days; failure to respond leads to cancellation of the application, preserving the right to reapply.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Commercial Registration, Tax Card and Publication
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial Registry Office of the Ministry of Supply and Internal Trade and the Egyptian Tax Authority
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon GAFI approval, the company must be entered in the Commercial Registry and receive the commercial registration number. The managers must attend in person or by authorized proxy to submit specimen signature cards, the registered office lease, and the incorporation approval. Immediately thereafter, apply to the Egyptian Tax Authority for the tax card (including income tax and VAT registrations) and, where relevant, to the Social Insurance Authority for workforce registration.
required_dossiers: GAFI incorporation approval and the notarized Memorandum of Association
Signed lease contract of the registered office
Manager specimen signatures and identification documents
GAFI commercial registration and tax application forms
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax authority delays the VAT certificate, apply for a provisional tax number and submit the final VAT registration within three business days after receiving the temporary number; the commercial registration may proceed in parallel.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Communications and Information Technology – Information Technology Industry Development Agency (ITIDA), in coordination with the Egyptian Unified Procurement Authority and the Ministry of Health Digital Health Registration Desk
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Digital Health Software Deployment Permit (EMR Module) and ICT Service Provider Registration Certificate

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category B2 – Low-Impact Registration / Exempt from Full EIA; the company engages in office-based software operations without manufacturing discharges.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No process wastewater or industrial air emissions generated. Compliance with municipal solid waste handling directives, hazardous e-waste control measures under Law No. 4/1994 and its executive regulations, and applicable ambient noise limits in commercial zones.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety clearance from the General Department of Civil Defense for the registered office and server hosting area; structural and occupancy load inspection certificate from the local municipality; workplace health and occupational safety clearance issued by the Ministry of Labour.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) – Official Portal: www.eta.gov.eg
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign legal entities engaging in taxable activities in Egypt must register for a Tax Identification Number (TIN) and VAT ID through the ETA's unified registration process. The foreign entity appoints a tax agent/fiscal representative, submits notarized and legalized certificate of incorporation, passport copies of authorized signatories, evidence of a local bank account or principal place of business, and a power of attorney. Registration is lodged online via the ETA portal or at the affiliated tax office; a registration certificate is issued within 30 business days. For non-residents, registration is required before any invoice issuance in Egypt or once an Egyptian withholding obligation arises.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation – Egyptian limited liability companies are taxable persons subject to corporate income tax on worldwide income unless a treaty limitation applies; no pass-through taxation for LLCs except for certain exempt legal forms not applicable here.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Egypt does not operate a US-style check-the-box election. An LLC may not elect to be taxed as a pass-through entity. The Tax Procedure Law No. 206 of 2020 and Income Tax Law No. 91 of 2005 do not provide hybrid classification elections for domestic entities; however, hybrid mismatch rules under the tax treaty network and Egyptian CFC rules may recharacterize certain payments. Foreign entities may apply for advance pricing agreements or tax rulings, but not for entity tax status changes.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under Law No. 67 of 2016 (amended)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EGP 500,000 annual taxable turnover for resident businesses; for non-resident suppliers, registration is mandatory without turnover threshold when providing taxable electronic services to Egyptian consumers (e-services subject to reverse-charge or simplified registration).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Egypt has mandated electronic invoicing and e-receipts through ETA-integrated protocols. All B2B taxpayers above the relevant thresholds must issue invoices via the ETA e-invoicing system (XML/JSON via API, with fiscal coding and QR stamping). Real-time clearance is required for e-receipts in B2C transactions. Non-compliance results in fines, blocked tax credits, and suspension of VAT refunds.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods exported outside Egypt are zero-rated. Services supplied to non-residents and consumed outside Egypt, including software/SaaS licences where beneficial use is outside the country, qualify for zero rating if the service provider is a VAT registered resident and retains evidence of overseas consumption. EMR SaaS provided to foreign clinics may qualify as a zero-rated export service when payment is received in convertible currency and the recipient is a non-resident business.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Bill of Lading or Airway Bill (or electronic delivery proof for digital services)
Inward Remittance Certificate (bank credit advice confirming FX inflow)
Signed contract / license agreement for services
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The ETA may audit all supporting export documents. Fraudulent claims for zero-rating trigger: (i) revocation of the export exemption, (ii) retroactive VAT collection at 14% plus late payment charges, (iii) an administrative fine up to EGP 1 million or twice the tax evaded for reckless negligence, and (iv) criminal liability under Tax Procedure Law with imprisonment or criminal fine (composite penalties). The limitation period for VAT assessment in fraud cases is 10 years.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Egypt (CBE) and the Egyptian Foreign Exchange Committee, operating under Law No. 194 of 2020 concerning the Central Bank and the Banking System; the CBE exercises monopoly authority over exchange-rate policy, foreign-exchange licensing, and capital-account administration.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Egypt operates a managed-float legal-tender regime for the Egyptian pound (EGP) with current-account convertibility in principle under Law No. 194/2020; capital-account transactions, including equity capital contributions, profit repatriation, and cross-border loan repayment, require underlying documentation, CBE approval, and use of an authorized dealing bank. For an EMR/HealthTech SaaS exporter, subscription and implementation fees constitute current-account service revenues and are generally remittable after tax and customs verification; however, profit/dividend remittance triggers a 5% withholding tax (or treaty-reduced rate), Corporate Tax Clearance Certificate, and CBE form documentary validation. No blanket convertibility guarantee exists for non-residents; formal clearance from the General Department of Foreign Exchange at CBE is recommended for principal repayment and dividend transfers.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Export proceeds for services and goods must be repatriated through CBE-licensed banks within 30 days from the date of invoice/transaction date as per CBE regulations; 100% of receipts are required to be recorded with the authorized bank and have to be converted into EGP at the official market rate to cover local expenses unless a retention account or intra-group netting permission is granted by CBE. The exporter must submit the export invoice, customs/service declaration, bank credit advice, and proof of performance to support settlement; failure to comply may block customs clearance and trigger fines under Egyptian export-import regulations.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Low. Offshore digital banks/EMIs (e.g., Wise, Revolut Business) are not regulated by CBE and cannot open EGP accounts, issue Egyptian IBANs, or settle local payroll/tax obligations. Their viability is limited to receiving USD/EUR subscription revenue from overseas medical clients and disbursing funds to Egyptian bank accounts via wire transfer; all onshore EGP liquidity and CBE compliance must flow through a licensed Egyptian commercial bank.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Directors and designated signatories must normally attend a physical on-boarding interview at the Egyptian bank branch; remote account opening is possible only for existing high-value clients of the bank and generally not for newly formed non-resident-owned LLCs. An original notarized and apostilled Power of Attorney in favor of a resident authorized officer may substitute for physical appearance if accepted by the bank's compliance committee, but the final sign-off requires at least one physical visit of the authorized officer and submission of original corporate books.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Shareholder register, notarized and apostilled certificate of incumbency, passport copies of all ultimate beneficial owners (UBOs), bank references from parent/holding entity, audited financial statements and sworn source-of-wealth declaration.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident Director and cross-border jurisdiction overlay
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Board resolution appointing resident manager, Power of Attorney, Commercial Registry certified foreign parent documents, and proof of tax residency (tax card / certificate of residence) for the parent entity.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: SaaS subscription cross-border flow without invoice/documents
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed EMR software licensing agreements with medical-clinic customers, invoice schedule with client details, export service declaration, cash-flow forecast, and recording of outbound subscription invoices in an accounting ledger.

HIPAA/ISO 27001 / GDPR compliance certificates, privacy policy, business-continuity and data-processing agreements, and a detailed controller-to-processor mapping showing that the EG entity holds only anonymized/activation log data rather than patient medical records.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source of initial capital and suspected round-tripping
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A grant letter / equity subscription agreement, bank statements from originator, SWIFT MT103 credit advice, board minutes capitalizing the LLC, and confirmation that the capital amount does not exceed the minimum prescribed by CBE anti-money-laundering thresholds.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Cross-border equity capital must be routed by SWIFT MT103 from the parent company account in the originating jurisdiction to the beneficiary account at a CBE-licensed Egyptian bank, using CBE purpose code for equity participation and the bank's inward remittance form. The bank will require the underlying incorporation certificate, Commercial Registry number, tax card, and board resolution to approve the credit as capital. The amount will be automatically registered to the LLC's capital account and reported to CBE for the balance-of-payments statistical survey. The remitter should include the LLC's Common Identification Number / Tax National Number in the wire message to prevent blocking.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For service purchases and software subcontractor payments, the primary clearing rails are SWIFT MT103 with full mandatory remittance info and CBE Form 7 for outbound service/import settlement; for physical equipment, a commercial documentary credit (Documentary Letter of Credit in USD/EUR, subject to UCP600) is required when the supplier requires shipment-backed liquidity. Payment schedules must be underpinned by authentic invoices, contract, and customs/import declarations; the bank may request a Corporate Tax Clearance Certificate before remitting dividends or foreign loans, while cross-border disbursements of intra-group royalties require a tax residency certificate and double-taxation treaty declaration.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore plain-vanilla FX forwards with a CBE-licensed bank, covered by a real current-account exposure (invoice/LC) and settled by gross delivery of USD against EGP.
Cross-currency interest-rate swaps only where the base obligation is a CBE-approved onshore loan and the swap is executed through an authorized dealing bank with exchange-rate-risk management filing.

Offshore non-deliverable forward (NDF) contracts with non-resident financial institutions are permitted only to hedge non-resident minority-owner cash-flow exposure and cannot be used to speculate or circumvent CBE conversion rules.
FX swap / spot concurrent with export proceeds conversion is allowed but must be booked on the same value date and reported to CBE as a current-account conversion.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return (Tax Form No. 17) with audited financial statements
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 4 months of fiscal year-end; calendar-year LLC: 30 April
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late penalty of 4% per month of tax due (capped at 40%), plus default interest at 18% p.a.; administrative assessment and aggressive enforcement in the event of non-filing

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) – Taxpayer Services Center
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Before 31 January of the following tax year; renewal application must be submitted before expiry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fine up to EGP 2,000 and restrictions on customs clearance, notarization, public tenders, and bank file updates; non-renewal can trigger suspension of the tax file

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Ultimate Beneficial Owner (UBO) confirmation statement
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Authority for Investment (GAFI) / Commercial Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 31 March for the preceding year; updates within 15 days of any shareholding transfer or UBO change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fine of EGP 10,000–50,000 for false, incomplete, or late UBO data; repeated non-compliance may lead to administrative strike-off of the commercial registration

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: General Assembly-approved audited financial statements and minutes
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: AGM no later than 3 months after fiscal year-end; approved statements and minutes filed within 1 month of approval
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative penalty of EGP 5,000–50,000; persistent failure may result in suspension of commercial registration and judicial dissolution under Companies Law 72/2017

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory for all LLCs regardless of size; at least one independent auditor licensed in Egypt must be appointed by the General Assembly under Companies Law 72/2017
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Egyptian Accounting Standards (EAS), substantially IFRS-converged, issued by the Accounting Standards Board under the Egyptian Financial Supervisory Authority

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The Managers and members must review the Register of Members and the UBO Register at each annual meeting. Any direct or indirect shareholder holding 25% or more must be re-confirmed. Share transfers triggering UBO changes must be filed with GAFI/Commercial Registry within 15 days using Arabic statutory forms. The confirmation is recorded in the General Assembly minute book and signed by the authorised manager.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: US$300–US$800 per year in Cairo/Alexandria for registered office and filing agent
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: US$1,500–US$4,000 per year for a typical EMR/software LLC with limited transactions

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Standard CIT 22.5% on taxable profits of EG LLCs under Income Tax Law No. 91/2005 as amended by Law No. 14/2020. SME election: Law No. 152/2020 on Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises allows a final presumptive CIT of 0.5% of annual gross receipts for taxpayers with turnover not exceeding EGP 10,000,000, subject to simplified books and no statutory audit. Export-oriented SaaS entities licensed in GAFI Public Free Zones may enjoy 0% CIT on export income, substituted by an annual ad valorem free-zone fee of up to 1% of the value of goods/services entering or leaving the zone. HealthTech/EMR projects may also claim Investment Law No. 72/2017 incentives, including up to 50% deduction of certain investable costs in underdeveloped governorates, and accelerated depreciation for software and cloud infrastructure.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form No. 19 (Corporate Income Tax Return for Juridical Persons) filed electronically through the Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) e-Filing portal (https://www.eta.gov.eg / unified e-Tax platform). Quarterly estimated advance payment vouchers are separately filed via the same portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual final return, with quarterly estimated CIT instalments based on the immediately preceding year's assessed liability.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: No later than four (4) months after the end of the tax year (e.g., 30 April for a 31 December year-end). The tax year is the calendar year unless the Ministry/ETA has approved a different fiscal year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name, ETA tax card number (RG code), commercial registration number, file number, head office address, and unique tax code for e-invoicing
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Insert the EG LLC's Egyptian Tax Number and the parent/foreign shareholder's country of residence and tax ID if disclosed; non-resident ultimate beneficial owners must be listed in the ownership annex.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Accounting period start and end dates (from MM/DD/YYYY to MM/DD/YYYY) and status of the first or final tax period if the LLC was incorporated or liquidated mid-year
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Ensure the period matches the period approved in the LLC's Egyptian Articles of Association and the audited IFRS financial statements; any change of fiscal year requires prior ETA approval.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total gross revenue from EMR SaaS subscriptions, software licensing, clinical workflow implementation fees, hosting and support services, net of VAT invoiced
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Declare all worldwide revenue attributable to the Egyptian permanent establishment; cross-border SaaS export revenue must reconcile with the ETA e-invoicing and e-receipt encoded documents.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Direct costs allocable to revenue: cloud hosting, data-center fees, third-party APIs, medical device integrations, and direct implementation labour
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Intercompany cloud and sub-processing fees must be supported by arm's-length agreements; disallow any payments to affiliates without substance or valid contracts.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Salaries and social insurance, rents, depreciation of software and equipment, marketing, legal/professional fees, and administrative overhead
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Payroll must match monthly withholding returns (Form 41); foreign director fees are deductible only if services are genuinely rendered in Egypt and arm's-length.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Non-deductible expenses: corporate income tax itself, fines, penalties, bribery payments, entertainment above the legal ceiling, unsubstantiated reserves, and interest on unpaid tax
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident-related management fees and royalties are administratively scrutinized and must be evidenced by transfer pricing documentation, otherwise automatically disallowed.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable profit after all statutory adjustments, computed before applying loss carry-forwards (maximum 5 years)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders must book a permanent-establishment allocation of income if strategic decisions, contract signature, or key servers are located in Egypt.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: CIT of 22.5% applied to taxable income, or the MSME presumptive tax of 0.5% of gross receipts if validly elected and eligible
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The reduced MSME rate is available to foreign-owned LLCs only while turnover remains under statutory limits and the owner qualifies under Law 152/2020.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 7 - Advance Payments and Withholding Tax Credits
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Quarterly CIT instalments already paid, WHT credits on interest/royalties/contracts, and any foreign tax credit claimable under an applicable treaty
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach ETA-approved payment receipts and DTA foreign tax credit certificates; claiming credits without treaty/TRC support will trigger a full audit.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Balancing figure: CIT payable after credits, or refund claim with supporting bank details
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For non-resident dividend distributions, a 10% dividend WHT must be declared and collected separately; unpaid balances block export of profits and trigger travel bans on directors.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Signature and stamp of the legal representative (chairman/managing director) and the licensed tax accountant registered with the ETA
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The Egyptian-resident general manager or tax agent must sign; a non-resident sole shareholder cannot solely sign without an Egyptian tax power of attorney.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty of EGP 1,000–5,000 (discretionary up to EGP 20,000 for repeat breaches) plus an automatic monthly late-payment surcharge of 2% of the outstanding tax for each month or part of a month of delay. Under-declaration attributable to negligence attracts an additional difference-based penalty of up to 50% of the tax omitted; willful fraud escalates to 100%–200% of the evaded tax and criminal prosecution. Continued default permits ETA asset attachment and travel-ban orders against the legal representative.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% final withholding tax on cash or in-kind profit distributions made by an Egyptian LLC to any shareholder, including non-residents, per Article 57 of Law No. 91/2005 as amended. The LLC is obliged to withhold, report, and remit the tax within the statutory monthly declaration windows.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To apply a reduced DTA dividend/interest/royalty rate, the non-resident beneficiary must (1) obtain an annual Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) from its home tax authority, legalized/apostilled with an Arabic certified translation; (2) submit a written treaty-relief application, the TRC, and proof of beneficial ownership to the Egyptian Tax Authority Central Department of International Taxation before the payment date for at-source relief; (3) obtain the ETA's reduced-rate clearance letter and retain it in the withholding files. If tax is withheld at the full domestic rate, the non-resident may file a refund claim within the five-year statutory limitation period along with the same TRC and treaty documentation. Egypt applies the OECD Model MAP provisions, and the ETA may deny treaty relief absent documented economic substance.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Domestic statutory WHT on royalties paid to non-residents: 20% of gross payments for the use of IP, software, patents, and trademarks. Domestic statutory WHT on interest paid to non-residents: 20% of gross interest on loans, bonds, and credit facilities. Egypt's DTAs commonly reduce royalties and interest to 10%–15% (e.g., 15% under the US-Egypt DTA in typical royalty/interest cases) and dividends to 5%–15% depending on shareholding level; each treaty must be verified for its specific rate and subject-to-tax clause.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File: contemporaneous transfer-pricing documentation is mandatory when the aggregate annual value of controlled transactions by the EG LLC exceeds EGP 8,000,000. Master File: required where the multinational group's consolidated annual revenue exceeds EGP 2,000,000,000. Country-by-Country Report: required where group consolidated revenue exceeds EGP 15,000,000,000. A TP disclosure form and confirmation of related-party transactions must accompany Form 19 regardless of value thresholds.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: Comparable Uncontrolled Price (CUP) – preferred by the ETA
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Egypt has no formal UAE-style Economic Substance Regulations, but applies a statutory General Anti-Abuse Rule (GAAR) and a substance-over-form doctrine under Law No. 206/2020 and ETA practice. The ETA disregards arrangements lacking commercial rationale, employees, premises, or actual risk-bearing functions, and may recharacterize the transaction, deny treaty benefits, and impose the 22.5% CIT debit on deemed Egyptian-source income. A paper 'IP-holding' LLC or a foreign affiliate hosting the EMR platform without local staff and board minutes will be treated as a sham for transfer-pricing and withholding purposes.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Willful under-declaration of EMR SaaS subscription revenue, off-book Stripe/Bank_Transfer collections routed to foreign payment processors, use of fabricated cost invoices, or deliberate suppression of employee withholding returns to shrink taxable profit.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Articles 132–137 of Law No. 91/2005, imprisonment of not less than two years and a fine equal to the tax evaded up to double that amount, or either penalty; mandatory re-assessment with 2% monthly late-payment interest, administrative seizure of bank accounts, and annulment of tax payment certificates needed for Egyptian licensing.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Signing directors, the general manager, and the licensed tax accountant are personally prosecutable; conviction triggers imprisonment, travel bans, asset freezes, and joint and several civil restitution of the evaded tax. Argentine/Egyptian courts' veil-piercing doctrine exposes shareholders if the LLC is a sham vehicle.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining an LLC with only a letterbox office, zero Egyptian employees, no board minutes, no operating bank account, and all EMR licensing IP held offshore while claiming DTA or free-zone tax exemptions without actual business conduct in Egypt.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: ETA/GAFI strike-off or commercial registry de-registration under the Investment and Companies Laws; retroactive denial of treaty benefits; recharacterization of service fees as taxable Egyptian-source income; penalty of up to 100% of the tax difference and revocation of the free-zone license.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Managers become personally liable for the LLC's unpaid CIT, VAT, and WHT arrears under Article 80 of Law No. 91/2005; travel bans and disqualification from board memberships are imposed in GAFI enforcement proceedings.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to prepare contemporaneous Local File/Master File, refusal to produce the TP file within the ETA examination window (30 days of request), non-arm's-length intercompany royalties for the licensed EMR software, or mispriced management fees to a foreign parent with an unjustified low TNMM margin.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative fixed fine of up to EGP 200,000 for documentation violations; the ETA may apply best-judgment income estimation, impose a tax-difference penalty of up to 50% of the attributed tax, and add the 2% monthly surcharge from the assessment date.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The CFO/finance director who certifies an inaccurate TP disclosure risks personal fines and imprisonment for false statements made to the ETA; travel bans regularly issue where TP adjustments exceed EGP 1,000,000 while the company is in collection stage.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating Stripe_Billing and international Bank_Transfer payment rails for medical-clinic clients without conducting KYC/due diligence, failing to appoint an MLRO, failing to report suspicious subscription/top-up flows to the Egyptian Money Laundering Combating Unit, or accepting funds from prohibited sanction-connected parties.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Law No. 80/2002 as amended by Law No. 112/2021, money laundering violations carry imprisonment of 7–15 years and fines of EGP 1,000,000–5,000,000; entity-level fines, freezing orders, and confiscation of funds in payment accounts are routinely ordered by the Economic Courts.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and compliance officers are personally indictable for culpable ignorance of AML controls; the management team may face travel bans, asset freezes, and personal criminal fines even where the company is ultimately acquitted of predicate offenses.
